plan_source: Wikimedia Commons File:Map of Gwalior Fort.jpg (1908 Gwalior State Gazetteer, drawn by A. Cunningham; Public domain per Commons)
plan_scale_bar: 0-4000 ft along the bottom edge; stated scale bar reads about 1.38 m/px but the fitted scale is 1.295 m/px (plan is about 6% stretched, as a hand-drawn sketch)
frame: OSM local metres, origin 26.2230701N 78.1659176E (data/traces/gwalior.trace.json), x east, y north
transform: osm_complex = a*(px - i*py) + b, with plan pixel (px, py down) ; invert for plan from osm
accuracy: about +-35 m near the tanks and Teli ka Mandir; larger toward the north (Man Mandir palace, gates) where the OSM outline departs from the hachured scarp by up to about 60-100 m. Use plan positions as relative placement only, snapped to mapped lines where one exists.
overlay: docs/fort-fidelity/shots/gwalior-plan-registration-overlay.png (red OSM outline, blue tanks, green markers, orange wall way, purple roads)
